description: This topic covers the parts of a circle, the main circle theorems, chord and tangent properties, and calculations of arc length and sector area.

mcq.questionText: An angle subtended by an arc at the centre of a circle is 110 degrees. What is the angle subtended by the same arc at the circumference?
mcq.explanation: The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference subtended by the same arc, so 110 / 2 = 55 degrees.

mcq.questionText: The straight line drawn from the centre of a circle to any point on the circle is called the:
mcq.explanation: A radius joins the centre of a circle to any point on its circumference.

mcq.questionText: An angle in a semicircle is always equal to:
mcq.explanation: The angle subtended by a diameter at the circumference is a right angle (90 degrees).

mcq.questionText: In a cyclic quadrilateral PQRS, angle P = 95 degrees. What is the size of angle R?
mcq.explanation: Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary, so angle R = 180 - 95 = 85 degrees.

mcq.questionText: A tangent to a circle meets the radius drawn to the point of contact at an angle of:
mcq.explanation: A tangent is always perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact.

mcq.questionText: Two angles in the same segment of a circle are subtended by the same chord. If one of them is 38 degrees, the other is:
mcq.explanation: Angles in the same segment subtended by the same chord are equal, so both are 38 degrees.

mcq.questionText: The length of an arc that subtends an angle of 90 degrees at the centre of a circle of radius 14 cm is (take pi = 22/7):
The area of a sector with angle 60 degrees in a circle of radius 6 cm is (take pi = 22/7):
From an external point, two tangents are drawn to a circle. A correct statement about these tangents is that they are:
mcq.explanation: Two tangents drawn from the same external point to a circle are equal in length.

mcq.questionText: A chord of length 16 cm is at a perpendicular distance of 6 cm from the centre of a circle. The radius of the circle is:
mcq.explanation: The perpendicular from the centre bisects the chord, so half-chord = 8. Radius = sqrt(8^2 + 6^2) = sqrt(100) = 10 cm.

mcq.questionText: AB is a diameter of a circle and C is a point on the circumference. If angle CAB = 35 degrees, then angle ABC is:
mcq.explanation: Angle ACB = 90 degrees (angle in a semicircle), so angle ABC = 180 - 90 - 35 = 55 degrees.

mcq.questionText: A part of the circumference of a circle between two points is called a/an:
mcq.explanation: An arc is a portion of the circumference of a circle between two points.

mcq.questionText: The angle subtended at the centre of a circle by an arc of length 11 cm in a circle of radius 7 cm is (take pi = 22/7):
mcq.explanation: Arc = (theta/360) x 2 x (22/7) x 7 = 11, so (theta/360) x 44 = 11, giving theta = 11 x 360 / 44 = 90 degrees.

mcq.questionText: PA and PB are tangents from an external point P to a circle with centre O. If angle APB = 50 degrees, then angle AOB is:
mcq.explanation: In quadrilateral OAPB, angles OAP and OBP are each 90 degrees, so angle AOB = 360 - 90 - 90 - 50 = 130 degrees.

mcq.questionText: The reflex angle at the centre of a circle subtended by an arc is 250 degrees. The angle subtended by the same arc at a point on the major arc (using the non-reflex angle) is:
mcq.explanation: The non-reflex angle at the centre is 360 - 250 = 110 degrees, so the angle at the circumference is 110 / 2 = 55 degrees.

fib.questionText: The angle at the centre of a circle is _____ times the angle at the circumference subtended by the same arc.
fib.explanation: By the angle at the centre theorem, the central angle is twice the angle at the circumference on the same arc.

fib.questionText: A chord that passes through the centre of a circle is called the _____.
fib.explanation: The diameter is the longest chord and passes through the centre of the circle.

fib.questionText: The opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral add up to _____ degrees.
fib.explanation: Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary, summing to 180 degrees.

fib.questionText: The perpendicular drawn from the centre of a circle to a chord _____ the chord.
fib.explanation: The perpendicular from the centre to a chord divides the chord into two equal parts.

fib.questionText: The arc length of a circle of radius 21 cm subtending an angle of 120 degrees at the centre is _____ cm (take pi = 22/7).
The area of a circle of radius 7 cm is _____ square cm (take pi = 22/7).
fib.explanation: Area = (22/7) x 7 x 7 = 22 x 7 = 154 square cm.

fib.questionText: If a tangent makes an angle of 90 degrees with a line at the point of contact, that line passes through the centre and is the _____.
fib.explanation: A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact.

fib.questionText: In a cyclic quadrilateral, if one angle is 70 degrees, its opposite angle is _____ degrees.
fib.explanation: Opposite angles are supplementary, so 180 - 70 = 110 degrees.

fib.questionText: The area of a sector with central angle 90 degrees in a circle of radius 14 cm is _____ square cm (take pi = 22/7).
Two tangents drawn to a circle from the same external point are _____ in length.
fib.explanation: Tangents from an external point to a circle are always equal in length.

tf.questionText: The angle subtended by a diameter at the circumference of a circle is always 90 degrees.
tf.explanation: This is the angle in a semicircle theorem.

tf.questionText: Angles in the same segment of a circle subtended by the same chord are unequal.
tf.explanation: Angles in the same segment subtended by the same chord are equal.

tf.questionText: A tangent to a circle touches the circle at exactly one point.
tf.explanation: By definition, a tangent meets a circle at only one point, the point of contact.

tf.questionText: The opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are equal.
tf.explanation: Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary (sum to 180 degrees), not necessarily equal.

tf.questionText: A diameter is the longest chord of a circle.
tf.explanation: The diameter passes through the centre and is the longest possible chord.

tf.questionText: The angle at the centre of a circle is half the angle at the circumference subtended by the same arc.
tf.explanation: The angle at the centre is twice (not half) the angle at the circumference subtended by the same arc.

tf.questionText: Equal chords of a circle are equidistant from the centre.
tf.explanation: Chords of equal length lie at equal perpendicular distances from the centre.

tf.questionText: A sector is the region enclosed by a chord and the arc it cuts off.
tf.explanation: That region is a segment; a sector is enclosed by two radii and an arc.

tf.questionText: The radius drawn to the point of contact of a tangent is perpendicular to the tangent.
tf.explanation: The radius at the point of contact is always perpendicular to the tangent.

tf.questionText: If a quadrilateral has all four vertices on a circle, its diagonals must be diameters.
tf.explanation: A cyclic quadrilateral's diagonals are not necessarily diameters; they are only chords unless the quadrilateral is a rectangle.

summary.correctAnswer: The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference on the same arc.
summary.explanation: Central angle = 2 x inscribed angle subtended by the same arc.

summary.correctAnswer: The angle subtended by a diameter at the circumference is 90 degrees.
summary.explanation: Any inscribed angle standing on the diameter is a right angle.

summary.correctAnswer: Angles in the same segment subtended by the same chord are equal.
summary.explanation: Inscribed angles on the same side of a chord are equal.

summary.correctAnswer: Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary.
summary.explanation: The sum of each pair of opposite angles is 180 degrees.

summary.correctAnswer: A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact.
summary.explanation: The angle between a tangent and the radius at the contact point is 90 degrees.

summary.correctAnswer: Tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal in length.
summary.explanation: The two tangent segments from one external point have the same length.

summary.questionText: Perpendicular from centre to a chord
summary.correctAnswer: The perpendicular from the centre to a chord bisects the chord.
summary.explanation: It divides the chord into two equal halves.

summary.correctAnswer: Arc length = (theta/360) x 2 x pi x r.
summary.explanation: It is the fraction theta/360 of the full circumference.

summary.correctAnswer: Sector area = (theta/360) x pi x r squared.
summary.explanation: It is the fraction theta/360 of the total area of the circle.

summary.correctAnswer: A sector is bounded by two radii and an arc; a segment is bounded by a chord and an arc.
summary.explanation: These distinguish the two main regions inside a circle.

hoq.questionText: In a circle with centre O, A, B and C lie on the circumference. The chord AB equals the radius of the circle. What is the size of angle ACB (the angle subtended by AB at the circumference)?
hoq.explanation: Triangle OAB has OA = OB = AB (all equal to the radius), so it is equilateral and angle AOB = 60 degrees. Angle ACB = 60 / 2 = 30 degrees.

hoq.questionText: A circle has radius 10 cm. A sector of this circle has an arc length of 15 cm. Taking pi = 3.14, what is the area of the sector?
hoq.explanation: Area of a sector = (1/2) x arc length x radius = (1/2) x 15 x 10 = 75 square cm.

hoq.questionText: TP and TQ are tangents from an external point T to a circle with centre O. The radius is 5 cm and OT = 13 cm. What is the total length of the two tangents TP and TQ?
hoq.explanation: Each tangent length TP = sqrt(OT^2 - r^2) = sqrt(169 - 25) = sqrt(144) = 12 cm, so TP + TQ = 24 cm.
